investigations.title: Pig Butchering Investment Scam & Tornado Cash Laundering
investigations.investigator: Maharashtra Cyber CID & Financial Tracing Unit
investigations.description: Fake institutional crypto trading app lure. Victim funds bridged across Ethereum and routed through Tornado Cash privacy router. De-anonymized through temporal-volume correlation and unmasked at WazirX deposit gateway.
